title: UNEP IMEO MARS — Methane Alert and Response System
description: UN super-emitter alert system detected plumes + sources catalog. Global, multi-satellite.
data_download_procedure: Visit https://methanedata.unep.org/plumemap → 'Download data' button → opt for CSV bundle (zip with detected_plumes + detected_sources CSV + definitions PDF + LICENSE). No stable direct-link URL — refresh manual.
license_note: Non-commercial + share-alike. Raw bundle is NOT redistributed via this repo per license friction — must be re-downloaded by each user from data_url above. Project derivative (ingested GEE FeatureCollection) is held internally under RuPlumeScan/refs/imeo_mars_v1 and not redistributed; aggregate statistics are reported в research publications с attribution.

files.description: Per-detection event-level plume catalog (event id, date, lat/lon, satellite, sector, country, ch4_fluxrate, etc.)

files.sha256_n/a: license text — tracked indirectly via license_url. May vary across re-downloads (whitespace/encoding). Verified at retrieved_date_canonical to match the canonical CC license.

verification_procedure: Run `python src/py/setup/verify_imeo_mars_manifest.py` after re-download to check SHA-256 hashes match the canonical 2026-05-15 retrieval. Mismatch = data has been updated на upstream side; consult MARS changelog before re-ingesting к GEE.
